actual: False positive. They are 15/15a, 17/17a and 14/14a -- deliberate sub-lettered decisions. The detection regex '^## Decision [0-9]+' truncates '15a' to '15', so uniq -d reported a duplicate that does not exist. Only SD-30 has genuine duplicates (Decision 2 and 3 each appear twice: a supersession notice and the original text).
